2S WPSS No. 970 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Hem Chandra Joshi, Advocate for 
the petitioners.
Mr. N.K. Papnoi, Standing Counsel for 
the State/respondents.
Heard. 
Admit.
Learned C.S.C. takes notice on behalf 
of the respondents.
Respondents may file counter 
affidavit within four weeks. Two weeks 
thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if any, may 
be filed.
List on 27.10.2025.
Heard on Stay Application No. 1 of 
2025
It is the case of the petitioners that 
they have been working with the 
respondents/authorities for a long, but 
now, the respondents/authorities are 
orally directing the petitioners not to come 
for work and stopping them from work. 
They want to replace the petitioners from 
other set of workers.
Yesterday, learned State counsel was 
required to get instructions. He would 
submit that out of 19 petitioners, nine
petitioners are working with the 
department as a plantation worker, 
namely, Narayan Singh, Shamim, Gulsher, 
Krishan, Mithu Ram, Laxman Singh, 
Arvind Kumar, Hirden, and Satyam. 
It is the case of the petitioners that 
out of the above, the petitioner Shamim, 
Krishan and Arvind Kumar have been 
working for more than ten years.
Having considered, till the next date 
of listing, the services of the petitioners Shamim, Krishan and Arvind Kumar shall 
not be discontinued by the 
respondents/authorities and the other 
petitioners shall not be replaced by other 
set of outsourced persons.
Stay application stands disposed of 
accordingly.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 08.08.2025
Jitendra

2. Today the matter is listed on Withdrawal 
Application (IA/3/2025), filed on behalf of petitioner 
Nos. 1, 2, 4, 9, 10, 12 and 16. 
3. Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma, learned counsel 
appearing for the petitioners/applicants submitted 
that writ petition be dismissed, qua the applicants 
with liberty to them to file a fresh petition.
4. When this Court expressed its disinclination to 
grant liberty to file fresh petition, then learned 
counsel for the applicants submitted that he is not 
pressing the prayer for withdrawal of the writ 
petition.
5. In such view of the matter, Withdrawal 
Application (IA/3/2025) is dismissed as not pressed.
